title: Grok Bot gateway request (webhook POST body)
description: Sent by a caller as the JSON body of an HTTP POST to the gateway routine's webhook URL, with header `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. The gateway Bot treats every field as untrusted data.

request_id.description: Caller-generated lowercase UUIDv4. Doubles as the capability to fetch the result, so it must come from a CSPRNG and never be reused.

agent.description: Target agent id (preferred) or exact name. Required for read_transcript and send_message.

limit.description: read_transcript: max lines to return (newest page).

before.description: read_transcript: page back from this position (exclusive), as returned in a previous result's `next_before`.

message.description: send_message: text to relay. Relayed as data, tagged with request_id and caller.

priority.description: send_message: ask the gateway to relay with priority where supported.

caller.description: Free-text tag identifying the caller, e.g. claude-code@laptop/project. Informational, not authentication.
